test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-6) Official paper (Held On: 9 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
There are six persons – C, D, E, X, Y, and Z, each of different ages. Only one person is younger than Y. X is older than E but younger than D. E is older than Y. Neither D nor C is the eldest.

How many people are older than Z?
solution:
Given that:-

Only one person is younger than Y.

 
• Y > _ .

X is older than E but younger than D.

 
• D > X > E

E is older than Y.

 
• E > Y

Neither D nor C is the eldest.

 
• Z > D > X > E > Y > C
 
• Thus, no one is older than Z.

Hence, **"option 2"** is the correct answer.
